about: The ACP v1 values of creche-facade: the protocol version, the line cap, the answer to initialize and the creche extensions. Each message is one JSON-RPC line as the wire carries it. The facade and its tests read this file. The door tests read the capability of each extension.

new_session.about: The configOptions of a session that never set a level. The ACP door answers session/new with them, and its test holds its copy equal to this list. The facade answers session/load and session/set_config_option with the same list and the current level.

configOptions.name: Thinking
configOptions.description: How much the model reasons before it answers. More thinking takes longer and costs more.

usage.about: The usage_update of a turn end and of a session/load. used and size are the context fill of the last model call. The meta key holds the family key spend of its budget day and model.budget_usd_per_day, in USD.

rewind.about: Cut the session back to before one user message. messageId is the messageId of a user_message_chunk. The door lists the capability in the _meta of agentCapabilities in its initialize answer. A running prompt gets invalidRequest (-32600). A messageId of no user message gets invalidParams (-32602).
